answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel QA task, FinCode, built from professional exams. We also create two code-generation tasks CodeTAT-QA and CodeFinQA by reformulating the existing financial QA datasets TAT-QA  and FinQA .
answer_1.outputs: Python programs, numeric answers, code solutions, extracted quantity spans, multiple choice answers

answer_2.quote: We measure accuracy by comparing this numeric output with a ground truth reference value. Answers within 1% of the reference are considered to be correct.

answer_4.quote: Annotations included in BizBench were done by individuals with financial knowledge known to the authors. They volunteered to annotate and received no payment for their annotations. All annotators were made aware of the intended use of their data and consented to this use.
answer_4.guideline: Programs were manually verified before being added to the dataset.
